g.text: Evidence map, not a head-to-head performance plot. Prior values are copied as printed in the cited sources, with the authors' metric names and units;
the metrics differ in definition, denominator and unit and are not placed on a common scale. No prior method was reproduced. This study's results are
in Figs. 1 and 3. Reference numbers follow the paper's bibliography.
